sketches.mechanism: The `object` declaration creates a singleton — exactly one instance, forever alone, impossible to duplicate
sketches.resonance: Declaring yourself as an object means there will only ever be one of you, and no one can construct another.

sketches.mechanism: The `never` return type indicates a function that can never successfully return — combined with an infinite recursive call that never resolves
sketches.resonance: A promise that resolves to `never` is a waiting that cannot end — the type system itself forbids arrival.

sketches.mechanism: A goroutine sends on a channel with no receiver, blocking forever — a deadlock the runtime detects and kills
sketches.resonance: Speaking into a channel no one listens to is not patience; the runtime calls it fatal.
